# Pry Scraping API

> Professional web scraping with x402 crypto payments. 15-tier anti-detection fallback, AI extraction, auto-signup, CAPTCHA solving.

## Documentation

- [Full Docs](https://docs.pryscraper.com)
- [API Reference](https://docs.pryscraper.com/api)
- [x402 Payments](https://docs.pryscraper.com/x402)

## MCP Server

- URL: https://api.pryscraper.com/mcp/
- Transport: SSE, Streamable HTTP, stdio
- Auth: x402 pay-per-call (no account/API key for discovery; paid prefixes require an x402 payment signature or a paid-tier API key)
- Tools: 112
- Categories: 33

### pry_mega_search

Search the web with every engine at once and return one consensus-ranked list. Six independent engines are queried in parallel and each hit is ranked by how many engines independently found it, so a link four engines agree on outranks one only a single engine returned. Use when you want the best possible answer and do not need page bodies; for full-page reading use pry_search instead. For example pry_mega_search(query='best rust web frameworks 2026', num_results=10) returns one deduplicated list where every result reports how many engines found it.
